shell_command_template_deprecation.description:
The `command_line` `{platform}` `{name}` runs a command (`{program}`) that uses a template. For security, commands that use a template will run without a shell in Home Assistant 2027.4, so shell features (pipes, redirects, globbing, etc.) anywhere in the command will no longer work.

Update the command to avoid shell features, or move the logic into a script the command calls.
shell_command_template_deprecation.title: Command with a template uses shell features
